decision: Generated documentation includes grounded-compact-list and grounded-compact-item Lit components for compact repeated items that need a name, description, and optional link. Compact lists are intended for dense contexts that would otherwise use grounded-unit-card but do not need a full card frame.
name: Render compact linked item lists
description: Documents the compact list components so generated docs can show dense linked name-and-description rows without full unit cards.
